items.title: Section: Seven Great Natures Opens — the Greatness of the Teaching Itself, and the Greatness of Arousing the Aspiration for Awakening

items.zh: 諸菩薩乘與七大性共相應故，說名大乘。何等為七？一者、法大性。謂十二分教中，菩薩藏攝方廣之教。二者、發心大性。謂有一類，於其無上正等菩提發正願心。
items.en:
The bodhisattva vehicle is called the great vehicle because it is joined together with seven great natures. What are these seven? First, the greatness of the teaching. It refers, among the twelve divisions of scripture, to the extensive teaching contained within the bodhisattva canon.
Second, the greatness of arousing the aspiration. It refers to a certain class who arouse the correct vow towards unsurpassed, correct, complete awakening.

items.title: Section: The Greatness of Resolute Understanding, of Excellent Aspiration, and of the Provisions

items.zh: 三者、勝解大性。謂有一類，於法大性生勝信解。四者、增上意樂大性。謂有一類，已過勝解行地，證入淨勝意樂地。五者、資糧大性。謂福德資糧、智慧資糧修習圓滿，能證無上正等菩提。
items.en:
Third, the greatness of resolute understanding. It refers to a certain class who generate powerful faith and understanding towards the greatness of the teaching.
Fourth, the greatness of excellent aspiration. It refers to a certain class who have already passed beyond the stage of resolute practice and realised the ground of pure, excellent aspiration.
Fifth, the greatness of the provisions. It refers to the provisions of merit and of wisdom, cultivated to full completion, sufficient to realise unsurpassed, correct, complete awakening.

items.title: Section: The Greatness of Time, and of Complete Realisation — Closing All Seven Great Natures as Six Causes Producing One Culminating Result

items.zh: 六者、時大性。謂經於三無數大劫，方證無上正等菩提。七者、圓證大性。謂即所證無上菩提，由此圓證菩提自體，比餘圓證功德自體尚無與等，何況得有若過若增。當知此中，若法大性、若發心大性、若勝解大性、若增上意樂大性、若資糧大性、若時大性，如是六種皆是圓證大性之因。圓證大性，是前六種大性之果。
items.en:
Sixth, the greatness of time. It refers to passing through three great incalculable eons before finally realising unsurpassed, correct, complete awakening.
Seventh, the greatness of complete realisation. It refers to the unsurpassed awakening thus realised — this complete realisation of awakening's own essence has nothing equal to it even among the essence of merit realised by others, let alone anything that could surpass or add to it.
One should understand that, among these, the greatness of the teaching, of arousing the aspiration, of resolute understanding, of excellent aspiration, of the provisions, and of time — these six kinds are all the cause of the greatness of complete realisation. The greatness of complete realisation is the result of these preceding six kinds of greatness.

items.title: Section: The Eightfold Comprising of the Great Vehicle Opens — the Canon Itself, the True Meaning It Reveals, and the Inconceivable Power It Discloses

items.zh: 有八種法，能具足攝一切大乘。一者、菩薩藏教；二者、即於如是菩薩藏中，顯示諸法真實義教；三者、即於如是菩薩藏中，顯示一切諸佛菩薩不可思議、最勝廣大威力之教；
items.en:
There are eight factors that completely and fully comprise the entire great vehicle. First, the bodhisattva canon's own teaching. Second, the teaching, within this same bodhisattva canon, that reveals the genuine, true meaning of all phenomena.
Commentary: Regarding "the teaching that reveals the genuine, true meaning of all phenomena" — this is explained at length in the Chapter on Genuine Reality, one should understand.
Third, the teaching, within this same bodhisattva canon, that reveals the inconceivable, supreme, vast power of all buddhas and bodhisattvas.
Commentary: Regarding "inconceivable, supreme, vast power" — this is explained at length in the Chapter on Power, one should understand.

items.title: Section: Correctly Hearing the Teaching, and Correctly Reflecting to Arrive at Excellent Aspiration — the Wisdom of Hearing and Reflecting Comprising the Great Vehicle

items.zh: 四者、於上所說，如理聽聞；五者、如理思為先，趣勝意樂；
items.en:
Fourth, correctly hearing exactly what has just been explained above. Fifth, correct reflection taken as the guide, arriving at excellent aspiration.
Commentary: Regarding "arriving at excellent aspiration" — excellent aspiration is called supreme aspiration. One should understand that here, pure faith taken as the guide and discerning the teaching taken as the guide, together producing settled, confirmed resolute understanding regarding all the buddha's own teachings, is called a bodhisattva's excellent aspiration. This is as explained in the Chapter on Excellent Aspiration.

items.title: Section: Entering the Mark of Practice, Completing the Fruit of Cultivation, and Final, Ultimate Liberation — Closing All Eight Factors and the Great Vehicle's Own Complete Sequence

items.zh: 六者、趣勝意樂為先，入修行相；七者、入修行相為先，修果成滿；八者、即由如是修果成滿，究竟出離。如是菩薩勤修學已，能證無上正等菩提。
items.en:
Sixth, taking excellent aspiration as the guide, entering the mark of practice. Seventh, taking entry into the mark of practice as the guide, completing the fruit of cultivation. Eighth, through this very completion of the fruit of cultivation, achieving final, ultimate liberation.
Bodhisattvas who have thus diligently trained are able to realise unsurpassed, correct, complete awakening.
Commentary: Regarding "entering the mark of practice" and the like — the Chapter on Abodes explains: bodhisattvas at the abode of resolute practice, with respect to the bodhisattva's own mark-free cultivation, should be understood as setting forth towards it. Those at the abode of utmost joy, the abode of excellent moral discipline, the abode of excellent mind, and the abodes of excellent wisdom, with respect to that same mark-free cultivation, should be understood as attaining it. Those at the first mark-free abode, with respect to it, should be understood as completely realising it. Those at the second mark-free abode, with respect to it, should be understood as purifying it. Those at the abode of unobstructed understanding and the abode of supreme, complete accomplishment, with respect to the fruit of that mark-free cultivation, should be understood as receiving it. One should understand that, within this, everything from initial setting-forth through purification is called entering the mark of practice, while the final receiving is called completing the fruit of cultivation.

items.title: Section: Ten Kinds of Bodhisattva Opens — Naming the Full Sequence From Abiding in the Lineage to the Very Last Existence

items.zh: 何等菩薩勤修學已，能證無上正等菩提？當知菩薩略有十種。一、住種性，二、已趣入，三、未淨意樂，四、已淨意樂，五、未成熟，六、已成熟，七、未墮決定，八、已墮決定，九、一生所繫，十、住最後有。
items.en: Which bodhisattva, having diligently trained, is able to realise unsurpassed, correct, complete awakening? One should understand that bodhisattvas, in brief, comprise ten kinds: first, abiding in the lineage; second, already entered; third, not yet purified in aspiration; fourth, already purified in aspiration; fifth, not yet matured; sixth, already matured; seventh, not yet fallen into certainty; eighth, already fallen into certainty; ninth, bound to one more life; tenth, abiding in the very last existence.

items.title: Section: Already Entered, Not Yet Purified, and Already Purified in Aspiration

items.zh: 此中即住種性菩薩發心修學，名已趣入。即已趣入，乃至未入淨意樂地，名未淨意樂。若已得入，名已淨意樂。
items.en:
Here, a bodhisattva abiding in the lineage who has aroused the aspiration for awakening and begun cultivating the path is called already entered.
Continuing from this already-entered state up until entry into the ground of purified aspiration has not yet occurred, this is called not yet purified in aspiration.
Once such entry has already occurred, this is called already purified in aspiration.

items.title: Section: Not Yet Matured, Already Matured, and Not Yet Fallen Into Certainty — With a Note on the Middling Grade of Maturity

items.zh: 即淨意樂，乃至未入到究竟地，名未成熟。若已得入，名已成熟。未成熟中，乃至未得入決定地、決定行地，名未決定。
items.en:
Continuing from the state of purified aspiration up until entry into the ultimate ground has not yet occurred, this is called not yet matured.
Once such entry has already occurred, this is called already matured.
Among those not yet matured, continuing up until entry into the ground of certainty and the ground of certain conduct has not yet occurred, this is called not yet fallen into certainty.

items.title: Section: Already Fallen Into Certainty, Bound to One More Life, and Abiding in the Very Last Existence — Closing All Nine Detailed Explanations

items.zh: 若已得入，名已決定。已成熟中，復有二種。一者、一生所繫。謂此生無間，當證無上正等菩提。二、住最後有。謂即住此生，能證無上正等菩提。
items.en:
Once such entry has already occurred, this is called already fallen into certainty.
Among the already matured, there are further two kinds. First, bound to one more life — meaning that, without any interval after this present life, unsurpassed, correct, complete awakening will be realised.
Second, abiding in the very last existence — meaning that, remaining within this very life, one is able to realise unsurpassed, correct, complete awakening.

items.title: Section: The Conclusion — These Ten Kinds Exhaust Every Bodhisattva Who Genuinely Trains, Closing the Eighth of Nine Major Topics

items.zh: 如是如說從初種性，廣說乃至能證無上正等菩提十種菩薩，於菩薩學能正修學。此上更無能正修學、若於中學、若如是學。非如所說諸菩薩上更有菩薩，於菩薩學能正修學。
items.en:
Thus, as explained, from the first kind, abiding in the lineage, extensively explained through the tenth, capable of realising unsurpassed, correct, complete awakening, these ten kinds of bodhisattva are able to correctly train in the bodhisattva's training. Beyond these, there is no further bodhisattva able to correctly train, whether in the content to be trained in or in the manner of training. It is not the case that, beyond the bodhisattvas already described, some further bodhisattva exists who is able to correctly train in the bodhisattva's training.
Commentary: Regarding "content to be trained in" and "manner of training" — the seven bases of training, such as benefiting oneself and others, are called the content to be trained in, exactly as explained at length from the chapter on benefiting self and others through the chapter on awakening. Being resolved from the very outset to possess extensive resolute understanding, up through abiding in undistorted instruction and admonition, and the skilfully-embraced conduct of body, speech, and mind, are called the manner of training, exactly as explained in the chapter on the power of the lineage.

items.title: Section: Establishing Bodhisattva Titles Opens — Sixteen Names Shared by Every Bodhisattva Without Distinction

items.zh: 如是所說一切菩薩，當知復有如是等類無有差別隨德假名。所謂名為菩提薩埵、摩訶薩埵、成就覺慧、最上照明、最勝真子、最勝任持、普能降伏、最勝萌芽，亦名勇健，亦名最聖，亦名商主，亦名大稱，亦名憐愍，亦名大福，亦名自在，亦名法師。
items.en: Every bodhisattva already described, one should understand, further shares provisional titles established according to shared qualities, without distinction among them. These are called: bodhisattva; great being; one who has accomplished awakened wisdom; supreme illumination; most excellent true child; most excellent upholder; universal subduer; most excellent sprout; also called valiant one; also called most noble one; also called guide of caravans; also called greatly renowned one; also called compassionate one; also called greatly blessed one; also called one with mastery; also called dharma master.

items.title: Section: Boundless Individual Titles, and Distinguishing the Counterfeit Bodhisattva From the Genuine One — Chapter Eighteen and Fascicle Forty-Six Close in Full

items.zh: 如是十方無邊無際諸世界中無邊菩薩，當知乃有內德各別無量無邊假立想號。若諸菩薩現前自稱我是菩薩，於菩薩學不正修行，當知是名相似菩薩，非真菩薩。若諸菩薩現前自稱我是菩薩，於菩薩學能正修行，當知是名真實菩薩。
items.en:
In this way, throughout the boundless, limitless world-systems of the ten directions, the boundless bodhisattvas dwelling there, one should understand, further have boundlessly many provisional titles, each reflecting that bodhisattva's own particular inner virtue.
Commentary: Regarding "provisional titles established according to shared qualities, without distinction" and the like — the various provisional titles given here apply broadly to every bodhisattva of every kind alike. Each name is established according to this or that shared quality, not established individually according to each bodhisattva's own particular inner virtue, which is why it is said that these are without distinction.
If any bodhisattva, openly before others, calls themselves a bodhisattva, yet does not correctly train in the bodhisattva's own training, one should understand this to be called a counterfeit bodhisattva, not a true bodhisattva.
If any bodhisattva, openly before others, calls themselves a bodhisattva, and does correctly train in the bodhisattva's own training, one should understand this to be called a true and genuine bodhisattva.

blocks.text: The qualities chapter, and with it the first part of the Bodhisattva Ground, ends today. What makes the "great vehicle" great, the ten stages of a bodhisattva's life, and the names a bodhisattva is called.
Both lecturers: 方 means dharma, 廣 means great, so 方廣 (vaipulya) is "greatness of the Dharma".

"Passing through three incalculable eons before realising awakening"; the first six greatnesses are all causes of complete realisation, which is their fruit. Venerable Miào Jìng: śrāvakas take at most sixty eons, pratyekabuddhas a hundred.
Venerable Miào Jìng: the seven greatnesses focus on the meaning of "great"; these eight on "vehicle". Beings' wholesome roots in the Dharma begin with hearing.
From abiding in the lineage to abiding in the very last existence. Venerable Miào Jìng: one abiding in the lineage may not even believe in the Buddha now, yet has buddha-nature within.
"A bodhisattva abiding in the lineage who has aroused the aspiration and begun training is called already entered."
Venerable Miào Jìng: at the tenth ground the wholesome roots mature; the eighth is the ground of certainty, the ninth the ground of certain conduct.

subs.head: One more life; the last life

blocks.text: Both lecturers: "bound to one more life" is like Maitreya now in Tuṣita; "abiding in the last existence" is the bodhisattva who descends and shows the eight phases of a buddha's life.
Master Cháng Bǎi: there is intake and outflow, hence "caravan leader". The bodhisattva takes the Dharma as teacher, and so may be called "dharma-teacher".

Venerable Miào Jìng: 現前 means before the assembly; one may be partly genuine and mostly counterfeit. Master Cháng Bǎi: Maitreya urges disciples to be genuine bodhisattvas, not counterfeit ones. (Ru-Yi's "in the present moment" misses this sense.)

The four seals, two parables, and a long portrait of the bodhisattva's qualities. The chapter ends with a plain question for every reader: genuine, or only looking like one? Fascicle 47 begins the second part of the Bodhisattva Ground.

quiz.q: The first great nature — "the extensive (方廣) teaching of the bodhisattva canon." How do the lectures explain 方廣?
options: both: 方 means dharma, 廣 means great — 方廣 is "great dharma"
quiz.why: Both lecturers: 方 means dharma, 廣 means great — so 方廣 is "greatness of the dharma."

quiz.q: What is the "greatness of time," and how do the first six relate to complete realisation?
options: three incalculable eons before awakening; the first six are causes of complete realisation, which is their fruit
quiz.why: "Passing through three incalculable eons before realising awakening"; the first six are all causes of complete realisation, which is their fruit. Venerable Miào Jìng: śrāvakas take at most sixty eons, pratyekabuddhas a hundred.

quiz.q: How does Venerable Miào Jìng contrast the seven great natures with the eight factors?
options: the seven explain "great," the eight explain "vehicle"
quiz.why: Venerable Miào Jìng: the seven focus on the meaning of "great"; these eight on "vehicle." Master Cháng Bǎi agrees.

quiz.q: Of the ten kinds of bodhisattva, what are the first and last?
options: abiding in the lineage; abiding in the last existence
quiz.why: First, abiding in the lineage; tenth, abiding in the very last existence. Venerable Miào Jìng: one abiding in the lineage may not even believe in the Buddha now, yet has buddha-nature within.

options: a lineage-holder who has aroused the aspiration and begun training
quiz.why: "A bodhisattva abiding in the lineage who has aroused the aspiration and begun training is called already entered." Venerable Miào Jìng: arousing supreme bodhicitta is "already entered."

quiz.q: Where does Venerable Miào Jìng place the line between "not yet matured" and "matured"?
options: the tenth ground — roots then ripen
quiz.why: Venerable Miào Jìng: at the tenth ground, the wholesome roots mature; the eighth ground is the ground of certainty, the ninth the ground of certain conduct. Master Cháng Bǎi: noble bodhisattvas before the tenth are "not yet matured."

quiz.q: How do the lectures illustrate "bound to one more life" and "abiding in the last existence"?
options: both: one more life is like Maitreya now in Tuṣita; the last existence is the bodhisattva of near-perfect awakening who descends and shows the eight phases
quiz.why: Both lecturers: "bound to one more life" is like Maitreya now in Tuṣita; "abiding in the last existence" is the near-perfect bodhisattva who descends and shows the eight phases. The English note's "one life away" contradicts "within this very life."

quiz.q: Among shared titles, why is a bodhisattva also called "caravan leader"?
options: bringing in and giving out, like a trader — hence "caravan leader"
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi: there is intake and outflow — hence "caravan leader." Venerable Miào Jìng: importing and exporting.

quiz.q: "Also called 法師" — rendered "teacher of the true teaching." How do the lectures explain it?
options: taking the dharma as one's teacher — the English leans towards "one who teaches"
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi: the bodhisattva takes the dharma as teacher, so may be called "dharma-teacher." The English stresses teaching others; the lecture stresses taking the dharma as one's teacher.

quiz.q: "Openly (現前) calling oneself a bodhisattva without training correctly is a counterfeit." The English says "in the present moment." How do the lectures read it?
options: Miào Jìng: "before the assembly"; partly genuine, mostly counterfeit; Cháng Bǎi: Maitreya urges us to be genuine, not counterfeit
quiz.why: Venerable Miào Jìng: "現前" means before the assembly; one may be partly genuine and mostly counterfeit. Master Cháng Bǎi: Maitreya urges disciples to be genuine bodhisattvas, not counterfeit ones. The English "in the present moment" misses the sense.
